svg.text: DYNAMIC TEMPLATE • MOVING ARROWS & LIVE PACKETS
Retrieval Architecture Benchmark: Chunk-Only Vector RAG vs. Contextual Hybrid + GraphRAG + CRAG
Each bar pair is normalized to its own 'before' error rate; combining Contextual BM25, GraphRAG communities, and a Corrective RAG gate cuts failure modes across the board.
BEFORE: CHUNK-ONLY VECTOR RAG (RED) VS. AFTER: CONTEXTUAL HYBRID + GRAPHRAG + CRAG (GREEN)
Anthropic Contextual Retrieval benchmark: Contextual Embeddings + Contextual BM25 + Reranker
GraphRAG hierarchical Leiden community summaries + AlloyDB / Neo4j knowledge graph
Corrective RAG (CRAG) lightweight retrieval evaluator + query rewrite / web fallback
Deterministic citation check + JEV sentence-level entailment gate before user reply
embedding AND index in BM25 so exact SKUs, error
Extract (entity, relation, entity) triples and pre-
summarize Leiden clusters so global 'what are the
main themes?' queries resolve in 1 hop.
Score retrieved chunks with a fast classifier before
generation: if confidence < 0.7, strip noisy spans
Production RAG is a 3-tier routing problem: Contextual Hybrid BM25+Vector for point lookups, GraphRAG for multi-hop synthesis, and a CRAG evaluator to strip poisoned
Curated by Nitin Aggarwal • Google Cloud ADK + OpenHands Factory • Proprietary + Confidential
Sources: Anthropic Contextual Retrieval (Sep 2024) • Microsoft GraphRAG (Edge et al. 2024) • CRAG (Yan et al. 2024) • Aurimas Griciūnas
